en.name: Talangin
en.description: Talangin pays your suppliers upfront, up to 75% of your buyer's purchase order. You reimburse PasarMIKRO when your buyer pays. Get a quote.

acceptedAnswer.text: Talangin is a PasarMIKRO service for Indonesian agricultural commodity traders and processors. When you have a purchase order or contract from a buyer, PasarMIKRO pays your supplier upfront, up to 75% of that purchase order. You reimburse PasarMIKRO when your buyer pays.

mainEntity.name: How much does PasarMIKRO pay upfront?

acceptedAnswer.text: Up to 75% of your buyer's purchase order or contract. The exact amount is set for each purchase order.
The fee depends on the agreed payment terms. Your quote shows the fee for your purchase order and payment term.
Typically between 3 and 45 days, in line with your buyer's payment terms.
Your supplier, directly into their bank account. All major banks are supported, including BRI, BCA, Mandiri and BNI.
Traders and processors of agricultural commodities who sell to verified buyers under a purchase order or contract.

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to get started?

acceptedAnswer.text: Up to 14 working days from your first quote, assuming complete documents.

id.name: Talangin
id.description: Talangin membayar pemasok Anda di muka, hingga 75% dari purchase order pembeli. Anda membayar kami setelah pembeli Anda membayar. Minta penawaran.

acceptedAnswer.text: Talangin adalah layanan PasarMIKRO bagi pedagang dan pengolah komoditas pertanian di Indonesia. Jika Anda memiliki purchase order atau kontrak dari pembeli, PasarMIKRO membayar pemasok Anda di muka, hingga 75% dari nilai purchase order tersebut. Anda membayar PasarMIKRO setelah pembeli Anda membayar.

mainEntity.name: Berapa yang dibayar PasarMIKRO di muka?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hingga 75% dari nilai purchase order atau kontrak pembeli Anda. Jumlah pastinya ditetapkan untuk setiap purchase order.
Biaya layanan tergantung pada kesepakatan. Penawaran Anda memuat biaya layanan untuk purchase order Anda.
Umumnya antara 3 dan 45 hari, sesuai tenor pembayaran pembeli Anda.
Pemasok Anda, langsung ke rekening banknya. Mendukung semua bank besar, termasuk BRI, BCA, Mandiri dan BNI.
Pedagang dan pengolah komoditas pertanian yang menjual ke pembeli terverifikasi dengan purchase order atau kontrak.
Paling lama 14 hari kerja sejak penawaran pertama, jika dokumen lengkap.

en.name: Talangin
en.description: Help your suppliers deliver more and faster. Based on your purchase orders, PasarMIKRO provides trade credit to your suppliers through Talangin.

mainEntity.name: Do we need to change our payment terms?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. You pay on the agreed payment date, as you do today.
Traders and processors who supply you under a purchase order or contract and pass PasarMIKRO's verification.
Contact our team on WhatsApp or by email. We will discuss which suppliers to start with.

id.name: Talangin
id.description: Bantu pemasok Anda mengirim lebih banyak dan lebih cepat. Berdasarkan purchase order Anda, PasarMIKRO menyediakan kredit dagang bagi pemasok lewat Talangin.

mainEntity.name: Apakah tenor pembayaran kami perlu diubah?

acceptedAnswer.text: Tidak. Anda membayar pada tanggal pembayaran yang disepakati, seperti sekarang.
Pedagang dan pengolah yang memasok Anda dengan purchase order atau kontrak dan lolos verifikasi PasarMIKRO.
Hubungi tim kami lewat WhatsApp atau email. Kami akan membahas pemasok mana yang bisa dimulai lebih dulu.
